utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Rosa, I’ve been telling folks all over the block about the repair drive so nobody misses it—people are planning to bring tools and pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Vik—thank you for spreading the word. It’s next Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community lot, and I’m finishing the volunteer list tonight so I can match people to what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Glad to help, Rosa—I’ll keep repeating that it’s next Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community lot so folks show up ready to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Pia, I’m happy to help, but let’s first confirm the exact spot by the community center and set a clear start time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that would help a lot—if we lock down the exact drop-off spot and start time, then we can tell people clearly and avoid a mess.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, then let’s confirm which entrance or corner of the community center lot they’re using and settle on a start time before we spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can still bring a few tools by for the repair drive, if that would help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, thanks—I’d only heard rumors. Has it finally got a date, and do they still need more hands?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I only know they’re still pulling it together, but I’ll bring the tools by when I head over, and I think a few extra hands would still help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—thanks, Kira; I’ve got porch light, gate latch, and bench slat written down now, but could you remind me which stop we’re tackling first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before we pick a first stop, can you confirm whether Mara or Dev set the route and who’s definitely bringing the tools?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I can’t swear Mara or Dev set the route—I’ve only got Opal’s list, and Eli said we should set a clear schedule first. I’m blanking on who’s definitely bringing tools, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help Saturday morning—what tools do we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Gus is already bringing a drill, saws, and an extension cord, so I think we’re mostly covered there. I’m more trying to pin down the exact repair list and who’s handling drop-off before we ask for anything else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—if tools are mostly covered, let’s lock the repair list first and then see if any gaps pop up. I’m still good for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Ira, I’m helping pull folks together for the repair drive, and Faye can do 3:30 after pickup if we keep it quick—does that timing work on your end?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That should work for me if it stays quick—I’m still out running errands, so keep me posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’ll keep it at 3:30 and send a quick update if anything changes while you’re out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can be there early and stay a few hours, and I’ll bring the drill, ladders, and the extension cord.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot, Gus—thank you. We’ve got it penciled in for next Saturday at the community center, so I’ll count you in for early setup with the drill, ladders, and extension cord.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara—I’ll be there early next Saturday with the drill, ladders, and extension cord.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: So far I’ve got two porch steps, the Maple gutter, and that fence panel still needing fixes, and I’m tracking nails, tarps, gloves, tape, screws, plus zip ties and flashlights unless someone’s claimed them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—has anyone claimed the zip ties or flashlights yet, and what time do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No one’s claimed the zip ties or flashlights yet, so I’ve still got both on my list, and if you can be there by 9 we can sort supplies before folks spread out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Tess, I’ve got it marked at the community center parking lot this afternoon, but I still want to confirm the exact entrance before we head over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that sounds right to me too, Opal—I’ve only heard the community center parking lot this afternoon, so let’s make sure on the entrance before everyone starts carting things over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Exactly—I’ve got the community center parking lot noted, but I want the precise entrance or corner pinned down before we send anyone over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m still catching up on it, but it sounds like folks are getting the word out pretty well.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, it’s picking up fast—Saturday around ten at the community shed, and we’ve already got people talking tools, spare parts, and fixes. If you hear anyone else asking, send them my way or just tell them to come by.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—good, okay, Saturday at ten by the community shed. I’ll pass that along if anyone asks, since I’m just getting the hang of it myself.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Faye — we’re planning to start around 9, and I’m sorting the donated tools first so we can focus on the urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but 9 won’t work for me with school drop-off—could I come by around 3:30 after pickup instead?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a big help, Faye—3:30 works fine, and we should still have plenty to do by then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, I’m running a little late, but I can still swing by soon and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane—before you head over, can you confirm whether you know the time for next Saturday and if anyone’s definitely covering bike or small appliance repairs yet?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still catching up, so I don’t know the exact time yet, and I haven’t heard for sure who’s covering bikes or small appliances. I can check when I get there, though.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mara, I heard the repair drive’s really picking up, and you’d mentioned you’ve got extra screws and a good drill to bring over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, I’m bringing the screws and drill next Saturday at the community center, and I’m still waiting to confirm who can cover the bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great—I’ll keep it to the screws and drill for now, then, till you’ve got the bike and small appliance folks confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Jules, I may be mixing the repair stuff up, but I’ve got community garden at 9 for fence and bench repairs, and I think the porch steps and hall roof were the other big priorities.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, that matches what I’ve heard too—the porch steps and hall roof are the main repair drive jobs, and I can help make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—if you’re talking to folks, Sam and Priya already said yes, and Luis might be in too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Kira — I’m still out running errands, but send me the latest on tools or volunteers when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I can, but can you first confirm who’s definitely organizing it and which tools or volunteers are already committed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m helping coordinate it, but I’m still waiting on the latest headcount—Leo’s definite for Saturday morning with a hammer and work gloves, and we still need an extra ladder.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 works well for me right after pickup—I can come by then with the blender.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye—that works. For the repair drive Saturday morning, we still need a couple of hammers and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can bring a pair of work gloves, but Saturday morning’s a little tight with school stuff—what time are you setting up?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Morning, Pia — we’re starting the repair drive around 9, and I’m sorting the donated tools first while Eli and I make a list of the urgent homes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, Sam, but where are people dropping things off, and who’s keeping the check-in list so nothing goes missing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Drop-offs should come to the community hall by 9, and I’ll keep the check-in list while I sort the tools so everything stays accounted for.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, thanks, Vik; I’ve got Mrs. Vale’s porch light, the garden gate latch, and the bus stop bench on the list, so should we stick with tomorrow morning to sort the order?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, tomorrow morning works—I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive, so I’ll keep spreading the word and let them know we’re sorting the order then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, perfect—thanks, Vik; I’d better write that down so I don’t muddle it, and tomorrow morning we’ll sort the fixes in order.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m coming in a bit late, but I can still swing by for the repair drive—do you know what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I think the main thing still missing is a confirmed exact setup spot by the community center parking lot, and we should make a clear list of repairs before you come over.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’m running a little behind anyway, so if you lock in the setup spot and jot down the repair list, I’ll head over and jump in as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring the drill and both ladders, and I can get there early to help set up if that works.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps—I'd only heard bits and pieces. Do you know if they've settled on the date yet, or are folks still sorting that out?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t heard a firm date yet—sounds like folks are still sorting it out, but I’m ready with the drill and ladders whenever they lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, before we lock anything in, can you confirm the time for next Saturday and whether anyone’s definitely covering bike and small appliance repairs?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m not totally sure on the time yet, and I don’t want to tell you wrong — I’m still piecing it together, but I can check who’s definitely covering bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — please check both and let me know once the time and repair coverage are confirmed so we don’t assume anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m tracking tape, gloves, screws, nails, and tarps so far, and zip ties plus flashlights still weren’t marked last I checked. If you know what’s still missing for the repair drive, tell me and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve heard Mara can bring extra screws and a good drill, and folks are dropping by tools and spare parts all afternoon. If zip ties and flashlights are still open, I can start nudging neighbors about those next.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d help a lot—go ahead and nudge folks about the zip ties and flashlights, and I’ll mark screws as covered a bit better with Mara pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: We’ve at least got the fence panel covered on my end, and Gus said he can bring tools. I’d still want to confirm the drop-off spot and who’s tracking things before we put the word out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m tracking it, and I still have the repair drive noted at the community center parking lot this afternoon—we should confirm the exact entrance or corner before we put the word out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps—if you’re tracking it, I’d just like to pin down the exact corner at the community center before we tell folks where to bring things.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can still bring a few tools by for the repair drive when I head over, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That helps a lot, Uli—thank you. We’re set for next Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community lot, so bring whatever basics you can and I’ll fold it into the final list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I’ll bring a small set of basics by next Saturday, then. If anything changes on your list tonight, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mara, before we announce anything, can we settle on one clearly marked drop-off spot and one person to keep the list?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes—let’s use the front table at the community center as the drop-off spot, and I can keep the list until Cleo’s supply count comes in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that helps—I’m good with that as long as the table’s clearly marked and we know where everything’s being stored after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still trying to pin that down—do you know what needs fixing most, or should we check with Cleo for the current list?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’d check with Cleo for the current list, but I’ve been telling folks to bring tools and pitch in since the repair drive’s shaping up to need plenty of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense—I’ve heard Gus can bring a drill, saws, and an extension cord, so if Cleo has the list we can match people and tools a little better.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules, before we lock anything in, can you confirm how many houses still need repairs and who’s definitely covering bike and small appliance fixes?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: From what I’ve got so far, a few houses still need repairs, and the bike and small appliance spots are basically covered, but I want to double-check the final list with Mara before I promise exact names.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules—let’s wait for Mara’s confirmation before we finalize anything, and then we can pin down the house count and exact repair leads.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Bo, from what I’m hearing it’s buzzing already—people are bringing tools and odd bits by all afternoon, so if you’ve got something to pitch in, now’s a good time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good to know—I’ll swing by the community center lot this afternoon and check what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect—ask who’s coordinating when you get there, would you? Folks are keen, but the details have been a bit all over the place.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, 9 to noon works—can you bring the drill and ladders for sure, and do you have extra gloves or tape on hand?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ll be there from 9 to noon with the drill and ladders for sure, and I can bring some extra tape too, but I’m low on gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—bring the tape then, and how much extra do you have so I can figure out whether I need to round up more gloves from someone else?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—next Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community lot, and I’m finalizing the volunteer list tonight; so far Mateo and Jen are confirmed, and we’ve got two ladders, a power drill, and a basic toolbox lined up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Rosa—I’ve got the repair drive pinned at the community lot next Saturday from 10 to 2; can you confirm which entrance or corner we’re using so I mark it exactly?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Use the east-side entrance by the garden beds, Opal—that’s where we’ll set up check-in and tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, that’s fine—I'll keep the tools ready and bring them over when I head that way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, perfect—thanks, Uli. I’m still catching up on the repair drive details, but that’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure—just let me know where you want me to drop them, and I’ll bring them by when I head over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m ready to spread the word fast, but first I’m trying to pin down the drop-off times and pickup plan for the repair drive—have you heard the latest?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest—I’m still out running errands, so keep me posted once the drop-off times and pickup plan are nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do—I’m checking around now, and as soon as the drop-off times and pickup plan are set, I’ll pass it along to you and the rest of the block.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Sam, thanks for checking in; can you remind me where we’re starting for the repair drive so I don’t mix up the order again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’re starting at 9 and focusing first on the homes with urgent fixes, and I’m bringing my tools to help get things organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, thanks, Sam—that helps a lot. So we start at 9 with the urgent house fixes first, and I’ll try not to scramble the order again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, spare screws, nails, and tarps on my list so far, but zip ties and flashlights still look unclaimed unless someone’s taken them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take the flashlights if that helps, but I’d need to drop them off between about 8:30 and 2:30 around school runs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps a lot—I'll mark flashlights down under you, and a drop-off anytime between 8:30 and 2:30 works just fine.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Leo, can we confirm with Mara or Dev first who’s coordinating, what tools are actually needed, and where everything’s supposed to be stored?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m coordinating it. Gus has the drill and ladders, I’ve got a hammer and gloves, and we can store everything in my garage after Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but can you confirm Mara and Dev are good with that plan too, and do we have a simple list of who’s bringing what?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
